a factual claim about stock, price or an order must come from a tool call
against the database. An answer with no tool calls that nonetheless states
a price is a failure, however plausible it reads.

the unbranded label. The real name is never in this payload for an
unbranded lot, because filtering it in the client would mean shipping it
to the client first.

unbranded brand's lots together and match them to its named ones.

B: new or unused, no tags, minor shelf wear, no functional defect.
C: factory seconds or visible defects, each one itemised.

at the point of use is a feature nobody is surprised by at the end of the

PhotoProtectionStatus.description:
Where one photograph stands on the way to an unbranded listing.

PENDING: not inspected yet.
CLEAR: no brand mark to hide.
BLURRED: a protected copy exists with the marks hidden.
NEEDS_REVIEW: a person has to decide before a buyer can see it.
FAILED: inspection did not complete, so nothing is known about it.

schema, and offering it here would promise something the database refuses.

A band and a reason, never a single confident number.

band with its reasoning is the honest way to show that. It becomes a real
prediction in Phase 6 when actual sales exist to learn from.
